meta.description: Demo/reference dataset for the Nutri static site: foods, MET exercises, activity levels, and condition-based food exclusions. Values are approximate; not for clinical use.

units.foodBase: per 100 g unless servingLabel says otherwise

filteringHowTo.rule: For a chosen dietaryConditions[].id, EXCLUDE a food if ANY applies: (1) food.id is listed in excludeFoodIds, (2) food.category is in excludeCategories, (3) food.tags intersects excludeTags.
filteringHowTo.disclaimer: Educational guidance only; not a substitute for professional diagnosis or treatment.

tagDefinitions.highSugar: High free/added sugars or candy-like product
tagDefinitions.refinedCarb: Refined starch (white bread, regular pasta, etc.)
tagDefinitions.highStarchCarb: Starchy carb that can spike glucose if portions are large
tagDefinitions.naturalSugar: Whole fruit sugars (portion still matters for diabetes)
tagDefinitions.glutenRiskOats: Oats may be cross-contaminated unless certified GF
tagDefinitions.acidic: Relatively acidic (may bother reflux in some people)
tagDefinitions.highPurineModerate: Moderate purines (relevant for gout in some diets)
tagDefinitions.highPotassium: Relatively high potassium (CKD caution varies by stage)
tagDefinitions.highOxalate: Oxalate-rich (some kidney stone diets limit these)
tagDefinitions.migraineTrigger: Common self-reported migraine triggers (demo, not universal)
tagDefinitions.tyramineRich: Tyramine (aged cheese; relevant for some migraines / MAOI meds)
tagDefinitions.histamineRisk: Higher histamine risk (canned fish, aged cheese — demo)
tagDefinitions.fodmapHeavy: Higher FODMAP load for IBS demo (legumes, some fruits)
tagDefinitions.goitrogenLight: Goitrogens (crucifers; usually fine cooked; demo flag)
tagDefinitions.calciumRich: Calcium-rich dairy (can affect non-heme iron absorption if same meal)

activityLevels.label: Very active
activityLevels.hint: Very hard exercise or physical job

dietaryConditions.name: Type 2 diabetes
dietaryConditions.note: Removes sweets/chocolate/bars, added-sugar products, and refined bread/pasta. Savory snacks like hummus stay. Whole fruits stay unless you switch to diabetes_type2_strict_carbs.

dietaryConditions.name: Type 2 diabetes (stricter carbs & fruit)
dietaryConditions.note: Also excludes starchy sides (rice, potato, oats, legumes as tagged) and whole fruits in this demo list.

dietaryConditions.name: High blood pressure
dietaryConditions.note: Excludes items tagged high-sodium (e.g. canned tuna, cottage cheese, cheddar).

dietaryConditions.name: Celiac disease / gluten sensitivity
dietaryConditions.note: Excludes gluten grains and non-certified oats in this demo tagging.

dietaryConditions.name: High blood lipids (LDL)
dietaryConditions.note: Excludes items tagged high in saturated fat; explicit IDs cover cheese and ground beef.

dietaryConditions.name: Acid reflux (GERD)
dietaryConditions.note: Demo only: acidic fruit, chocolate, very fatty cheese patterns; real triggers vary.

dietaryConditions.name: Gout
dietaryConditions.note: Flags moderate-purine fish/meat and canned tuna in this demo; real limits depend on attacks/meds.

dietaryConditions.name: Kidney disease (high potassium caution)
dietaryConditions.note: Many CKD diets restrict potassium only at certain stages/labs — this is a teaching filter only.

dietaryConditions.name: Kidney stones
dietaryConditions.note: Not all stone formers need the same diet; many factors (fluids, calcium timing) matter.

dietaryConditions.name: Migraine
dietaryConditions.note: Triggers are highly individual; chocolate/citrus/aged cheese are frequent self-reports.

dietaryConditions.name: Irritable bowel (IBS)
dietaryConditions.note: Real low-FODMAP care is phased/reintroduction; this only tags heavier items in the list.

dietaryConditions.name: Histamine intolerance
dietaryConditions.note: Aged cheese, canned fish, chocolate flagged; real sensitivity varies a lot.

dietaryConditions.name: Fatty liver (NAFLD)
dietaryConditions.note: Broad metabolic pattern demo; clinical plans are individualized.

dietaryConditions.name: PCOS
dietaryConditions.note: Similar to limiting high-GI added sugars/refined starches in many counseling approaches.

dietaryConditions.name: Heart failure
dietaryConditions.note: Often overlaps with hypertension salt limits; fluid limits are separate in real care.

dietaryConditions.name: Iron deficiency anemia
dietaryConditions.note: Tea/polyphenols can reduce non-heme iron absorption if taken with iron-rich meals. Calcium-rich dairy can too when paired — counsel timing separately; not all dairy is excluded here.

dietaryConditions.name: Hypothyroidism
dietaryConditions.note: Crucifers are usually fine in normal cooked portions; iodine/meds dominate real management.
